version.description: The @crvouga/atlas version the server runs, or null when it does not know

build.description: Where this server was built from. Absent from a server that predates it, which means unknown

version.description: The @crvouga/atlas version, or null for a source build or a build that does not know it

revision.description: The source revision (a git commit) it was built from (`ATLAS_REVISION`), or null

builtAt.description: When it was built, ISO 8601 (`ATLAS_BUILD_TIME`), or null

imageDigest.description: The container image digest, only when the deployment injected it (`ATLAS_IMAGE_DIGEST`); an image cannot know its own digest, so null otherwise. Absent for a viewer

role.description: What the token of this request may do. A server with no tokens treats everyone as admin

open.description: True when the server has no tokens at all

write.description: The id of the backend uploads go to

capabilities.description: Features this server has, by name: `events`, `ingest`, `store`, `checks`, `status`, `effective`. A client checks a name before using what it names

uploads.description: How this server takes uploads. Absent from a server that predates it: every upload goes through it

directOverBytes.description: Files larger than this go straight to storage (`POST /api/store/<key>?upload=start`, then `?upload=complete`); null when every upload goes through the server

streamMaxSeconds.description: The longest one /api/events stream lasts before the server ends it and the viewer reconnects; null or absent when streams last until the viewer leaves
